result.summary: 本文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个多语言语言模型，最大模型为 405B 参数的稠密 Transformer，上下文窗口最高 128K tokens [S1.p3]。论文详细描述了预训练与后训练流程，并进行了广泛的基准评测与人类评估 [S1.p6]。实验表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中，在相应识别任务上表现与最先进水平相当，但这些多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在提出一套新的语言基础模型 Llama 3，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。其动机是相比前代 Llama 模型，通过提升数据数量与质量、扩大训练规模来获得更强的模型能力 [S1.p5]。论文还探索通过组合式方法为 Llama 3 添加图像、视频和语音能力 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
Compared to prior versions of Llama, we improved both the quantity and quality of the data we use for pre-training and post-training.
We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，性能提升主要来自数据质量与多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。预训练使用约 15T 多语言 token，旗舰模型为 405B 参数，训练计算量约 3.8×10^25 FLOPs [S1.p5]。后训练采用监督微调（SFT）、拒绝采样（RS）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的相对简单流程 [S1.p5]。多模态能力通过组合式方法添加，包含语言模型预训练、多模态编码器预训练、视觉适配器训练、模型微调和语音适配器训练五个阶段 [S6.F28]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
our performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as by increased training scale.
We pre-train Llama 3 on a corpus of about 15T multilingual tokens, compared to 1.8T tokens for Llama 2.
we pre-trained a flagship model with 405B trainable parameters on 15.6T text tokens.
our flagship language model was pre-trained using $3.8\times 10^{25}$ FLOPs
we adopt a relatively simple post-training procedure based on supervised finetuning (SFT), rejection sampling (RS), and direct preference optimization (DPO;)

This approach leads to a multimodal model that is trained in five stages: (1) language model pre-training, (2) multi-modal encoder pre-training, (3) vision adapter training, (4) model finetuning, and (5) speech adapter training.

experiments.text: 论文在大量标准基准上评估预训练 Llama 3，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估八大类 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。后训练模型也在通用知识、指令遵循、编程、多语言和长上下文等基准上进行了评测 [S5.SS2.p1]。此外还进行了人类评估，比较 Llama 3 与竞争模型 [S1.p6]。多模态实验在图像识别（如 MMMU、VQAv2、ChartQA 等）[S7.SS6.p1]、视频识别（PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA、ActivityNet-QA）[S7.SS7.p1] 和语音任务（ASR、语音翻译、口语问答）[S8.SS4.p1] 上展开。

evidence.quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
We present results for our Llama 3 post-trained models on benchmarks across different capabilities.
In addition, we perform extensive human evaluations that compare Llama 3 with competing models.

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning:
We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks:
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验评估表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，接近最先进水平，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。Llama 3 8B 在几乎所有类别上优于竞争模型，70B 大幅超越 Llama 2 70B 和 Mixtral 8x22B [S5.SS1.SSS1.p4]。405B 模型在长上下文检索任务中实现 100% 的针检索性能 [S5.SS2.SSS6.p1]。多模态方面，Llama 3-V 405B 在所有图像识别基准上超过 GPT-4V，但略落后于 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet [S7.SS6.p2]；语音识别上优于 Whisper 和 SeamlessM4T [S8.SS4.p3]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
The results show that Llama 3 8B outperforms competing models in virtually every category, both in terms of per-category win rate and in terms of average per-category performance.
We also find that Llama 3 70B outperforms its predecessor Llama 2 70B by a large margin on most benchmarks, with the exception of commonsense benchmarks that are likely saturated.
Llama 3 70B also outperforms Mixtral 8x22B.
Our Llama 3 models demonstrate perfect needle retrieval performance, successfully retrieving 100% of needles at all document depths and context lengths.
Using the resulting Llama 3-V 405B model, we outperform GPT-4V on all benchmarks, while being slightly behind Gemini 1.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
our model outperforms models that are tailored to speech like Whisper and SeamlessM4T on all benchmarks.

limitations.text: 作者承认无法保证测试穷尽所有风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其在非英语语言和面对熟练对抗性红队时 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。人类评估可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S10.p3]。此外，大规模训练中的功耗波动对电网构成持续挑战 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p7]。

evidence.quote: However, no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.
While these models are still under active development and not yet ready for release, we hope sharing our results early will accelerate research in this direction.
This is an ongoing challenge for us as we scale training for future, even larger Llama models.
